Class UserAccounts

java.lang.Object
org.casserole.config.UserAccounts
@Component public class UserAccounts extends Object
The UserAccounts type loads the SSH password accounts for the server. SSH is the secure-shell protocol a client uses to connect. The load reads ./users.yaml, then user.home/.casserole/users.yaml, then the classpath resource users.yaml. The last step uses the casserole.ssh username and password from CasseroleProperties. The successful load stores a non-empty list of UserEntry rows and a source label. The type refuses an empty file, a root that is not a map, a missing users key, a users value that is not a list, an empty list, a duplicate name, a file with no valid rows, an unreadable file, and an unusable fallback pair. The load skips a non-map row, a blank name, a name RegionOwner.isValid rejects, and an empty password, and it prints each skip to standard error.

    • authenticate

      public boolean authenticate(String username, String password)
      The authenticate method reports whether one row matches the name and the password. The method returns false when the username is null. The method returns false when the password is null. The match is an exact equals on the name and on the password. The method returns false when no row matches.
      Parameters:
      username - The name to match.
      password - The password to match.
      Returns:
      Whether a stored row matches both values.

    • loadCascade

      private static UserAccounts.Loaded loadCascade(CasseroleProperties properties)
      The loadCascade method loads the first account file that exists. The method reads ./users.yaml when that path is a regular file. The method otherwise reads user.home/.casserole/users.yaml when that path is a regular file. The method otherwise reads the classpath resource users.yaml and labels it classpath:users.yaml. The method otherwise uses fallback(CasseroleProperties). The classpath stream is closed after the parse. The method ignores a close failure.
      Parameters:
      properties - The configuration that supplies the fallback username and password.
      Returns:
      The loaded rows and their source label.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The chosen file or the fallback pair cannot be used.

    • parseStream

      private static UserAccounts.Loaded parseStream(InputStream in, String source)
      The parseStream method reads one YAML document into account rows. YAML is the indentation text format of the file. The root must be a map that holds a users list. The method throws IllegalStateException when the document is empty, when the root is not a map, when users is missing, when users is not a list, when that list is empty, when a name is duplicated, or when no row is valid. The thrown message includes the source label. The method skips a non-map row. The method skips a blank name. The method skips a name that RegionOwner.isValid rejects. The method skips an empty password. The method prints each skip to standard error. The stringOf(Object) method trims a kept name and password. The method stores the first copy of a name as a UserEntry.
      Parameters:
      in - The YAML bytes to read.
      source - The label stored with the rows and written into failure messages.
      Returns:
      The valid rows and the same source label.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The document has no usable account list.

    • fallback

      private static UserAccounts.Loaded fallback(CasseroleProperties properties)
      The fallback method builds one account from casserole.ssh. The method uses an empty name and an empty password when the SSH section is null. The method uses an empty password when the stored password is null. The method throws IllegalStateException when RegionOwner.isValid rejects the name or the password is empty. The message is casserole.ssh fallback user/password is not usable. The source label is casserole.ssh.
      Parameters:
      properties - The configuration that supplies the username and password.
      Returns:
      One UserEntry and the source label casserole.ssh.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - The fallback name or password cannot be used.
